# MediaPipe Tasks Vision (vendored)

On-device face landmarks for the body language analysis in video mode. Served from this
repository so the page makes no third-party requests; nothing leaves the browser.

- `vision_bundle.mjs`, `wasm/vision_wasm_internal.*` from `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` 0.10.14 (npm)
- `face_landmarker.task` model, float16, version 1
